about.title: About Us
about.desc_1: MHD Valuation Company Limited (MHD) is one of the most professional valuation service providers in Vietnam, headquartered at 52 Tran Binh Trong, Binh Loi Trung Ward, Ho Chi Minh City.
about.desc_2: MHD is one of the enterprises with extensive experience in specializing in providing conditional valuation consulting services such as: business valuation, real estate valuation, movables, goodwill and other assets (for purposes: M&A, investment cooperation, mortgage borrowing, proving financial capacity, new asset procurement, asset liquidation, buying, selling, transferring real estate...). In addition, MHD also provides financial consulting services, compensation, site clearance...
about.vision_desc: As a young and dynamic enterprise, MHD aims to become a leading brand in the Valuation field and always accompany customers to success. To achieve this, MHD constantly trains to build a high-quality human resources team, knowledgeable in many fields; with synthetic and analytical skills; and especially always keeps in mind "Customer success is the guarantee for MHD's development".
about.mission_desc: MHD not only provides suitable services, real value to all customers but also contributes to building and cultivating a transparent, strong valuation market, contributing to the overall development of the community and Vietnam's economy.
about.core_values_desc: If you need prestige, speed, accuracy and transparency, please ACCOMPANY us. Proficient, masterful in professional operations, understanding and complying with regulations to best meet customer requirements. Each member always masters their work; thinking, acting to achieve the common goals of the MHD family.

process.title: Valuation Process
process.click_to_view: Click to view details of this step.
process.cta_desc: Our team of experts is always ready to advise and provide you with the best services.
process.meta_desc: Professional, transparent and optimized valuation process at MHD Valuation, helping customers receive results quickly and accurately.

step_1.title: Determine general assets and value
step_1.description: An important initial step to establish the legal foundation and valuation basis.
details: Determine basic legal, economic - technical characteristics of the asset.
Identify the user of the valuation results.
Determine the purpose and time of valuation.
Determine the value basis of the valuation.
Identify assumptions and special assumptions.

step_2.title: Make a valuation plan
step_2.description: To clearly determine the scope and progress of each work content scientifically.
details: Determine goals, requirements, scope and content.
Determine methods and procedures to proceed.
Determine necessary data, reliable document sources.
Build implementation schedule, human resource organization.
Determine whether to hire consultants (if any).

step_3.title: Field survey, information collection
step_3.description: The team of experts goes directly to the site to assess the actual condition of the asset.
details: Check the actual condition of the asset against the legal dossier.
Record factors directly affecting the asset value.
Collect market data, transaction prices of similar assets.
Study related macro and micro economic factors.

step_4.title: Information analysis
step_4.description: Use in-depth financial tools to assess and quantify risks.
details: Analyze the legality and planning of the asset.
Analyze the highest and best economic use.
Evaluate and process data collected from the market.
Select the most appropriate valuation method.

step_5.title: Determine value and make report
step_5.description: Complete dossiers, certificates and transparently transfer results to customers.
details: Run calculation models to produce estimated value results.
Prepare detailed, logical and strict valuation reports.
Internal quality control before issuance.
Issue official Valuation Certificates to customers.

why_choose_us.title: Why Choose MHD?
why_choose_us.f1_desc: At MHD, we constantly promote and develop our "warriors". The Board of Directors of MHD always orients and builds MHD to become the most ideal workplace for employees. Sharing sessions and training seem indispensable. Besides working hard, we also relax and motivate to participate in future battles.
why_choose_us.f2_desc: Salary level is determined based on experience, capacity, complexity and importance of each position. Salary review once a year based on performance. Quarterly bonus for sales staff exceeding targets and annual bonus for all employees. In addition, there are full allowances for meals, gasoline, telephone, and business trips.
why_choose_us.f3_desc: MHD constantly trains and promotes the development of individual warriors' skills through training and courses. You will have a clear career path and advancement that best suits your goals and participate in large-scale projects.

items.title: BONUS
items.desc: Income policy, remuneration and fair, transparent bonus regime. Full 13th month salary. Annual salary adjustment based on evaluation results.

items.title: HEALTH INSURANCE
items.desc: In addition to fully implementing the health insurance policy according to state regulations, MHD also supports employees with annual health insurance packages depending on their working time.

items.title: ANNUAL LEAVE
